scheduled.description: The dose is recorded as scheduled.

verified.description: The dose is recorded as verified.

cancelled.description: The dose is recorded as cancelled.

compounded.description: The dose is recorded as compounded on site.

licensed.description: The pharmacist is recorded as licensed.

dispenses.description: The pharmacist (first) is recorded as dispensing the dose (second).

replaces.description: The first dose is recorded as replacing the second dose.

label: bad
explanation: This statement says that every dose that is scheduled is verified unless the dose is cancelled and at least one pharmacist that is licensed dispenses the dose. It covers a cancelled dose that no licensed pharmacist dispenses by still requiring that dose to be verified if it is scheduled. Therefore it matches the requirement exactly.

requirement: Every dose that is scheduled is verified. The only exemption is for a dose that is cancelled and that at least one pharmacist that is licensed dispenses; both parts are needed for the exemption.
